Thanks for the heads up. Neha — can you please: 
- Confirm whether the original Workday invite created a pending verification record (we sometimes see an EIN mismatch flagged by the verification API).
- If so, re-send the supplier invite and trigger a manual verification.
- If manual verify fails, open a ticket with Workday support and escalate with the error code (Sara's screenshot shows a 403).

I attached the W-9 the vendor included by email (BlueRidge_W9.pdf). Diego — can you confirm the vendor EIN matches the W-9? If not, ask them to re-upload a corrected W-9.

Laura Bennett

Checked the supplier record in Workday — status is 'Pending Verification' and the automated check returned a 'Tax ID mismatch' flag (code TV-403). I re-sent a fresh invite and toggled manual verification; that pushed it into the 'Verification in progress' queue. I also opened a ticket with Workday: https://support.workday.com/ticket/WD-29817 (they assigned it high priority).

Notes / next steps for vendor: please accept the new invite and, when you see the "Confirm tax ID" prompt, select the radio box to upload the W-9 (not paste). If it still fails, reply here and we'll coordinate a short shared-screen session.

Ticket reference and internal tracker: SUP-4521.

Neha Kapoor
Procurement Operations | Redwood Inference
